function.name: car_set_voice
function.description: Change this tile's deliberate car-only reply voice override (persisted; available choices come from Vox). 'default' removes the override and restores the responding agent's assigned Hermes profile voice. A named Rick request explicitly selects Rick; it is not a reset. Does not change the profile or Telegram voice.

voice.description: A vox voice name or display name (walken, walken2, 'Morgan Freeman'), or 'default'.
